desc:
Battle using gubbies with unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses in order to take down the gubby kingdom. The gubby tower defense experience.

Join the group & like the game (optional) for +50 starting cash in a game.
Keep in mind that this is my first official game built by myself and some friends, the game is prone to balance changes and bugs.

[LATEST UPDATE]
15/08/2026: sandbox update, medic tower added, few bug fixes, new update log ui, and much more!
